f17c080f15.q: What was Hadley Nightingale's first real estate investment mistake and how much did he lose on his initial property purchase?
f17c080f15.a: Hadley purchased a block of land for $765,000 with a $100,000 overdraft around 2006-2007. He had a verbal corn contract with a farmer that fell through, the contractor kept pushing back the small job, and the crop degraded to grain worth only $23,000 instead of the expected $80,000. After working for approximately 10 years to keep the property afloat throughout his 20s, he eventually broke even and walked away, receiving $200,000 to $300,000 in tax losses that allowed him to pay no income tax for the next five years.

c408745380.q: How much did Hadley Nightingale earn per hour in New Zealand versus Australia, and why did he move?
c408745380.a: Hadley was earning $13 an hour in New Zealand on dairy farming, so he moved to Australia where he could earn $20 an hour working in mining and long-haul trucking. His philosophy was that by nearly doubling his wage, he could work harder and longer hours to service the debt from his failed property investment, driving 16 to 18 hour days to increase his income.
